reason: The spec's design (src/advice/preflop.ts imports and parses heads-up.json and full-ring.json at import, §5 'Files to create / modify' and D-3) breaks a locked TASK-7.2 test that is not covered by the Q-4 unlock: tests/advice/preflop.acceptance.test.ts 'AC#6 passing HandState to the advice API fails typecheck'. That test copies a fixed list of files (engine files, hand-class.ts, preflop-chart.ts, preflop.ts and charts/six-max.json only) into a sandbox and requires the control probe to typecheck with exit code 0. With the two new chart imports in preflop.ts, tsc in the sandbox reports TS2307 for both missing JSON files, so the control assertion fails. Any design in which recommendPreflop selects the heads-up/full-ring chart itself needs preflop.ts to import something outside that fixed list.
evidence: npx vitest run (non-tooling groups) -> FAIL tests/advice/preflop.acceptance.test.ts > AC#6 passing HandState to the advice API fails typecheck: 'src/advice/preflop.ts(3,22): error TS2307: Cannot find module './charts/full-ring.json' ... src/advice/preflop.ts(4,21): error TS2307: Cannot find module './charts/heads-up.json' ... expected 2 to be +0' at tests/advice/preflop.acceptance.test.ts:340 (file list at :297-306). Full-repo npm run typecheck passes. The spec's prototype measurement (§3) listed only unlocked failures because the prototype mapped the 6-max chart at every size and added no new imports.
options: (Recommended) Unlock tests/advice/preflop.acceptance.test.ts (owner TASK-7.2) for one edit: add 'src/advice/charts/heads-up.json' and 'src/advice/charts/full-ring.json' to the sandbox file list in the AC#6 test (2 added lines, no assertion changed). The test still proves what it proved before: HandState is rejected and PlayerView accepted.

Keep preflop.ts free of new imports: move HEADS_UP_CHART, FULL_RING_CHART and PREFLOP_CHARTS to a new module (e.g. src/advice/charts.ts) and have recommend() pick the chart and pass it as options.chart. recommendPreflop(view) without options would then not choose the size's chart by itself, which departs from §5 ('recommendPreflop picks the chart from the view's dealt-in seat count') and SPEC-04's recommendPreflop wording; a spec amendment is needed.
A chart registry in preflop.ts filled by a separate charts module at import (no static import from preflop.ts). Avoids the locked edit but adds hidden import-order coupling; not recommended.
